title: Arkansas homeowner wins appeal after neighbour's fence cuts trailer access from 20 feet to eight
summary_full: Roger C. Moore recently won an important legal battle concerning a land dispute with his neighbor Bob Robertson. The Arkansas Court of Appeals found that the lower court made several errors in its ruling favoring Robertson. Moore's access to a shared road was severely restricted by an extended fence that impacted his trailer's movement. The appeals court sent the case back for further hearings regarding property rights and road usage.
